The  best  sales  people,  they're  very  good 
 at  letting  silence  sit.  And  so,  if  you 
 tend  to  be  more  talkative  in  terms  of 
 talk  time,  I  would  encourage  you  to  try 
 this.  If  someone  says  something,  instead 
 of  immediately  jabbing  back,  sometimes 
 just  let  them  talk  more.  Just  give  them 
 more  time  to  talk  because  the  more  they 
 talk,  the  more  rapport  you  have  because 
 people  like  talking  about  themselves. 
 So,  they'll  think  that  you're  amazing 
 without  you  ever  saying  anything.
